original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_UBB_RTM0 through TEMP_UBB_RTM7 as eight UBB RTM thermal channels associated with the intended AMDGPU modules, with stable GPU identity and consistent SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence.
original_method: The platform owner defines RTM, maps indices to UBB positions and AMDGPU module serial/UUID/BDF identities, and supplies sensor-source semantics and limits; automation performs passive complete collection without executing the parenthesized annotation as shell text.
manual_activity: The GPU/thermal owner defines RTM, binds RTM0–RTM7 to fitted AMDGPU modules and sensing points, approves limits and confirms the Web mapping. The parenthetical text is not run as part of the command.
required_inputs: Authoritative RTM definition and UBB assembly/revision
RTM0–RTM7 population and UBB position to GPU serial/UUID/BDF map
Approved AMDGPU inventory source and BMC-to-OS identity correlation
Measurement source for every RTM channel and relation to GPU junction/board telemetry
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping
Units, scale, tolerance, freshness, unavailable semantics and condition-specific limits
Same-target IB/OOB identity plus BMC/SDR/GPU driver/firmware/spec revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent GPU/thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1877 and exclude the duplicate switch Web workflow
Enumerate RTM0 through RTM7 separately and never query the tilde label as one sensor
Do not append or execute the source's parenthesized AMDGPU annotation as shell syntax
Bind every BMC RTM channel to stable AMDGPU module identity before comparison
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus Web and passive driver/GPU context
Do not reload drivers, start workload, reset GPUs, change fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs; stop on mapping or thermal faults
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant, duplicate isolation and RTM/AMDGPU topology
Collect approved read-only AMDGPU identity without reload or reset
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus eight exact mapped RTM records
Prepare Web parity and passive XID/link/power/fan/SEL context
Perform no annotated-text execution, switch substitution, control action or verdict
engineer_actions: Define RTM and approve index-to-UBB/GPU/sensor-source map
Review eight-channel cross-domain evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Isolates the duplicate switch variant, prevents execution of annotation text, and requires stable BMC-to-AMDGPU identity so all eight RTM readings refer to the intended modules.
independent_technical_reasoning: BMC sensor indices and Linux GPU indices belong to different enumeration domains and may change independently. Serial/UUID/BDF correlation is needed to avoid comparing RTM3 with the wrong GPU, while telemetry cadence and proxy semantics must be known before treating driver and BMC values as equivalent.
